status: PARTIAL: baseline done, candidates not trained
blockedReason: BigQuery ML bills boosted-tree CREATE MODEL by compute, not by the ~1.5 MB the dry run reports. The Oct 2026 training of the current five m_* models billed 96.1 GB in total (7.4 to 49.7 GB per model, about 1,670 bytes billed per slot-ms; job bqjob_r4cfdf43fbdc1dad1_000001a12c5223a4_1). The task cap was 200 MB per query and 'keep total bytes billed small', so no CREATE MODEL was run. Needs Om's decision on a training budget; suggested first step is a single m2_warp config-A cost probe.

split.holdoutConditions: all holdout lots have ambient RH 75..98 %, i.e. a monsoon-only test; training covers RH 25..98

currentModelTraining.query: CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL m_* ... WHERE run_date < 2026-09-01, data_split_method RANDOM 0.2
currentModelTraining.features: all lots columns except ids, run_date, item_code and other labels (includes customer_id)

dropped.customer_id: not a physical driver; does not generalise to new customers

engineered.dew_point_c: Magnus dew point from ambient_rh_pct and ambient_temp_c

consideredNotUsed.month_of_year / monsoon flag: predict.sql sends no run date; monthly scrap means in lots move with RH, which RH and dew point already carry

features.computedIn: CREATE MODEL TRANSFORM clause, so ML.PREDICT takes the same raw inputs predict.sql already builds

B.modelName: m2_<defect>_b (copied to m2_<defect> if it wins)

notes: early stopping is not available with NO_SPLIT (BQML rejects min_relative_progress), so iterations are fixed
global explain is off to save compute; top drivers come from ML.FEATURE_IMPORTANCE
picking A vs B on the holdout is a mild selection effect on the reported candidate score
candidatePlan.validation: both CREATE MODEL configs pass a BigQuery dry run; the sweep query reproduces docs/evidence/humidity-sweep.json exactly when pointed at m_*
